lines.en: I come down the corridor, very slowly.

lines.zh: 我的脚步和我的身形不同步。
lines.en: My steps don't match my body.
I walk in the shadow, never out.
Each step shortens the gap.
The light dims a little as I pass.
My body is somewhat stiff.
My steps never hurry.
I stop behind you.
I turn very slowly.
With every step, my head does not turn away.
I squeeze through the door frame.
There's no sound as I come near.
I stand, my eyes not moving.
My face feels familiar.
I'm watching to see if you blink.
My arms hang stiff.
I'm taller than the door.
My chest does not rise or fall.
I tilt my head slowly.
I'm listening to the sounds in the room.
I don't speak; I only watch.
Light slides over me.
I know that face of yours.
You're looking at me. I'm pleased.
Do you remember the first time?

lines.zh: 我站在你视线边上，不动。
lines.en: I stand at the edge of your sight, motionless.
You should have gone to bed earlier.
I won't leave this time.

lines.zh: 你身上有我留下的东西。
lines.en: You still carry what I left on you.
Your lamp has very little oil left.
I want to hear you finish.
You shouldn't be alone.
This house has only one door.
I stood behind you a long while.
Take another look out the window.
There's no one else here now.
I'm in no rush to act.
What are you reaching for?
I told you, I'm not leaving.
I lurched, then straightened up.

lines.zh: 我的脸抽了一下，又正回来。
lines.en: My face twitches once, then settles back.
The word 'pain' means nothing to me.
I gave half a step and came back.
I am somehow still smiling.
A little blood is nothing.
I straighten my head.
Your strike was very low.

lines.zh: 我退了半步又回来，脸还在笑。
lines.en: I step back and return, still smiling.

lines.zh: 你端来的那点东西，我连看都不看。
lines.en: I do not even glance at what you bring.
Holding that up is laughable.
That's of no use to me.
Save it for your last meal.

lines.zh: 我这张脸，是从卡带里爬出来的。
lines.en: This face crawled out of a cartridge.
The smell of food makes me want to laugh.
Is that all you have?

lines.zh: 那道熟悉的旋律，把我从暗处叫出来。
lines.en: That familiar melody calls me out of the dark.
You pulled back; I paused.
Hit me and you'll feel cold.
I'm a good deal taller than you.
Pressed against me, you can't escape.

lines.zh: 我的手臂围住了你的肩。
lines.en: My arm has closed around your shoulder.
I didn't move at all from that.
Nothing separates us anymore.

lines.zh: 我比你高一大截，你贴着我逃不掉。
lines.en: I stand far taller; pressed against me, you cannot get away.
We were always together.
We don't part.

lines.zh: 它说话的时候用我的嘴。
lines.en: When it speaks, it uses my mouth.
We're the same mistake.
I can't recall which came first.
It's hungrier than I am.
We don't look for anyone else.
There are many of them, all here.
You can only see one.
I pick it up and look at it.
It's very light in my hand.
I can carry it without hands.
I gather whatever falls.
This was yours, wasn't it?
It's useless now.
I put it back.
I'll hold this for you.
Now I'm here.

lines.zh: 你退到书房角落，没路了。
lines.en: You back into the study corner; no way left.
We've already met.
This time I'll finish it.
I can see your face clearly.
No need to shout.
Your hand is feeling for the door.
I've tried that door.

lines.zh: 你翻过身时，我已经在床边。
lines.en: When you roll over, I am already at the bed.

lines.zh: 我的名字只有三个字母。
lines.en: My name is only three letters.
You have a few seconds left.
I've opened my eyes.
Do not walk any further that way.
I stay behind you without stopping.
Wherever you go, I'm there.

lines.zh: 我一步一步走，门一直关着。
lines.en: I walk step by step; the door stays shut.

lines.zh: 你的心跳在这屋里回响。
lines.en: Your heartbeat echoes in this room.
The door is close to you, far from me.
You've gone the wrong way.
You know this face.
You've come full circle.
Nor is there a path outside the window.
You are still counting, are you not?
The numbers don't add up anymore.
I stay just outside the frame.
This time I'm not hiding.
Try turning around.
I'm inside this very room.

lines.zh: 你握着刀的手，指节发白。
lines.en: The hand holding your knife has gone white at the knuckles.
I am extremely patient.

lines.zh: 我伸手抓住了你的手腕。
lines.en: I take hold of your wrist.
You are dragged half a step closer.
I didn't use much force.

lines.zh: 我按住你的肩，把你抵在门板。
lines.en: I grip your shoulder and press you to the door.
You won't see this one coming.
I'm right in front of your face.
Your breathing has gone thin.
I let go slowly.
That one drew no blood.
I retreat to the far end of the room.
Let's do that again.

lines.zh: 我嘴角动了一下，眼睛没动。
lines.en: The corner of my mouth moves; my eyes do not.

lines.zh: 你的手垂下去，我松开了。
lines.en: Your hand drops, and I let go.
Do not just fall asleep like that.
I came from behind the door.

lines.zh: 这间屋子又多了我一个。
lines.en: There's one more of me in this room.
My face appears first.

lines.zh: 光暗下来的时候我到了。
lines.en: I arrive when the light goes down.
I'm standing by your bed.
You haven't woken up yet.
A long shadow appears on the wall first.
How far had you counted?
I turn my face around slowly.
I have come back once again.
The whole house is quiet.
Can you hear me?
I said I'd come back.
I won't step away this time.
My feet are on the floorboards.
I have been in this house a long while.
That door is locked.
You have finally caught sight of me.

lines.zh: 火光照亮我的脸，太亮了。
lines.en: The firelight shows my face. Too bright.
I fall, and land without a sound.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，我照样看着你。
lines.en: Water fills my throat, and I keep watching you.
The blast throws me flat against the wall.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我的手，我还是伸着。
lines.en: An arrow passes through my hand; it's still reaching.
Light burns me and I withdraw slowly.

lines.zh: 我不进食，力气却在流失。
lines.en: I do not eat, yet my strength drains.
There are no walls here, and no doors.
